title: rand 0.8 in workspace — two versions pulled; should upgrade to 0.9
description: Cargo.toml pins rand = '0.8' while transitive deps pull in rand 0.9.4. Both versions are compiled and linked (confirmed via Cargo.lock). rand 0.8.x is a legacy release; upgrading to rand = '0.9' eliminates the duplicate and shrinks the dependency tree. rand 0.8 -> 0.9 has breaking API changes in RngCore; check all usage sites before upgrading.
